name: Apple Sauce
directions: Dice apples of your own choosing into bite size pieces
In a large pot, add apples and water and bring into a boil
Turn heat to medium and cover for about 20-25 minutes. Stir occasionally.
While boiling, take a taste, add sugar here if desired in 1 TBSP intervals.
Once apples are soft and fork tender, remove off heat and let cool for 5 minutes
Add the boiled apples to a blender and blend until smooth or use an immersion blender
Let the applesauce cool until desired temperature and enjoy!
